Tools / 01

Calculate volume and compare weights

Measure the outside of the closed parcel. Enter your service's divisor; the tool has no default divisor.

Result

All calculations run in your browser. Inputs are not sent to a Vijeron server.

Formula & limits

Volume = L × W × H. Litres = cm³ ÷ 1,000. Dimensional weight = cm³ ÷ your divisor. Girth = twice the sum of the two sides other than the longest.

The larger of actual and dimensional weight is a comparison only. Rounding, rates, size limits and billable-weight definitions depend on the carrier.

Measured Packaging

Geometry planning tools, not a rate quote, packaging certification or delivery guarantee.
